props.value: **MiT-B3 SegFormer encoder (45.2 M params)** + DeepLabv3+ decoder + 4 heads (seg / NDVI / NDRE / canopy) · **trained at 576×576**, predicts at native 600×600 via auto-resize · **4-flip TTA** at inference · self-supervised auxiliary loss with Kendall–Gal uncertainty weighting.

props.label: Full accuracy report (segmentation + per-task + aux heads)
props.name: accordion

props.value:
## Model accuracy

_MIT_B3 encoder · trained at [576, 576] · 4-flip TTA at eval._

### Segmentation (primary, supervised)

| Split | Tiles | Pixel acc | **3-cls mIoU** |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| val | 26 | 97.50% | **78.77%** |
| test | 26 | 97.86% | **81.40%** |
| test_balanced | 86 | 92.06% | **48.28%** |

_Model trained on the canonical 104-tile train split (sparsely-vegetated capture window). `val` and `test` are the held-out canonical splits. `test_balanced` (86) blends in 60 mid-/high-NDVI tiles for Task-1 Health F1 — but those tiles are out-of-distribution for this model, so its NDVI predictions and downstream Health F1 collapse there. Resolving that requires expanding the labeled training set across the full NDVI range, which is the next step in the project._

### Per-task metrics (precision-agriculture pipeline)

| Split | Task 1 — Health (F1) | Task 2 — NDVI (RMSE) | Task 3 — Stress (Acc / macro-F1) | Task 4 — Zoning (mIoU) |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| val | _n/a (single class)_ | 0.0669 | 97.81% / 68.44% | 58.03% |
| test | _n/a (single class)_ | 0.0660 | 98.43% / 70.67% | 57.90% |
| test_balanced | _n/a (single class)_ | 0.5420 | 32.24% / 24.76% | 49.40% |

_Task 1 (Health) F1 is **n/a on the canonical `test` split** because every tile there has NDVI<0.6 (sparsely-vegetated capture window → all labelled Stressed; F1 is undefined for single-class targets). The `test_balanced` split (86 tiles, mixed NDVI) is where Health F1 is meaningful._

_Tasks 3 (Stress) and 4 (Zoning) are scored against rule-based 'ground truth' computed by applying the same threshold rules to the **real** spectral bands. They measure how faithfully the model's NDVI/NDRE predictions reproduce the heuristic decisions a perfect spectrometer would._

### Auxiliary regression heads (self-supervised)

| Split | NDVI MAE [-1,1] | NDRE MAE [-1,1] | Canopy MAE [0,1] |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| val | 0.046 | 0.040 | 0.006 |
| test | 0.046 | 0.042 | 0.008 |
| test_balanced | 0.451 | 0.067 | 0.065 |
props.name: markdown

props.value:
### Pipeline
```
Input MS tile (5, 600, 600)
  └─► resize 576×576, /256 → [0, 1]
       └─► MiT-B3 encoder (4 stages, hierarchical ViT)
             └─► DeepLabv3+ decoder (ASPP + skip)
                   ├─► seg head     → (C, H, W)  argmax → class mask
                   ├─► NDVI head    → (1, H, W)  tanh → [-1, 1]
                   ├─► NDRE head    → (1, H, W)  tanh → [-1, 1]
                   └─► canopy head  → (1,)       sigmoid → [0, 1]
  └─► upsample seg/NDVI/NDRE → (B, *, 600, 600)
  └─► task_outputs.compute_all() → 5 precision-ag derivations
  └─► visual_report → Ollama LLM → farmer-language answer
  └─► write_prescription → 2-band GeoTIFF
```

### Dataset (WeedsGalore)
Labeled UAV multispectral tiles, MicaSense RedEdge-MX camera. 5 bands (B 475 / G 560 / R 668 / **RE 717** / NIR 840 nm), uint16 PNG @ 600×600. Maize crop with weed sub-species labels; severe class imbalance (bg ~83%). Model trained on 644 tiles (NDVI-balanced subset including healthy / moderate / low-NDVI samples) at 576×576.

### Released checkpoint
`runs/cropmsllm_vit.pt` — encoder `mit_b3`, train resolution [576, 576], 45.2 M params. Train ~25 min on RTX 4060 8 GB.

The FileData class is a subclass of the GradioModel class that represents a file object within a Gradio interface. It is used to store file data and metadata when a file is uploaded.

Attributes:
    path: The server file path where the file is stored.
    url: The normalized server URL pointing to the file.
    size: The size of the file in bytes.
    orig_name: The original filename before upload.
    mime_type: The MIME type of the file.
    is_stream: Indicates whether the file is a stream.
    meta: Additional metadata used internally (should not be changed).
